items.title: Why Wall Street isn't exactly loving Marvell's $115B Lumentum deal
items.summary:
Marvell Technology (MRVL) is making waves in the AI world after announcing a $115 billion all-stock deal to acquire photonic technology company Lumentum (LITE). Both stocks have had a rocky past month of trading.

Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa joins The 8:30 team in assessing the rest of Wall Street's reaction to this deal.

items.title: Lumentum (LITE) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Marvell Deal Tempers AI Optics Optimism
items.summary: Lumentum Holdings is under fresh scrutiny after its Fair Value Target shifted to about US$1,143.92 from roughly US$1,177.34, giving investors an updated reference point for what analysts think the stock could be worth. Recent research ties this change to a balance of optimism around Lumentum’s AI optics exposure and the planned all stock Marvell deal, set against concerns about deal risk, sector valuation and how much credit the stock receives for future AI driven demand.
